shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui/; git status --short | head -20

find src -type f | head -50 && cat src/*.tsx src/*.ts 2>/dev/null | head -150; cat index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts AGENTS.md .gitignore; ls -R .claude | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -120

grep -n -i -A12 "dashkit" .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -60; ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -150; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; npm view @gravity-ui/dashkit version peerDependencies 2>&1 | tail -30
npm view @gravity-ui/dashkit@10.5.2 dependencies peerDependencies 2>/dev/null; npm view @gravity-ui/icons version 2>/dev/null; npm view @gravity-ui/charts version 2>/dev/null

npm install @gravity-ui/dashkit@10.5.2 @gravity-ui/icons@^2 2>&1 | tail -5 && grep -n '"@gravity-ui\|"react' package.json && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh | head -30 && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh dashkit DashKit Dashkit Widget 2>&1 | head -80

bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh dashkit DashKit Dashkit 2>&1 | head -40; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/ node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs 2>/dev/null
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit && cat build/docs/INDEX.md; echo ----; wc -l README.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && rg -n -i -C3 "required setup|## Setup|import '@gravity|styles.css|ThemeProvider|configure\(" node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/README.md | head -80; echo ----; rg -n -C2 "registerPlugins|pluginTitle|pluginText|renderer|defaultLayout|editMode|overlayMenuItems|isMobile|gridLayout" node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/README.md | sed -n '1,200p' | head -150
sed -n 1,100p node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/README.md; echo ....; rg -n -i "renderer|PluginProps|ItemProps|PluginRenderer|context|setItem\b" node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/README.md | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit && cat package.json | rg '"(types|typings|main|module)"' ; ls build/esm | head; find build/esm -name "*.d.ts" | head -5; find build/esm -name "*.d.ts" | rg -i "plugin|index" | head -20
D=/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm; cat $D/typings/plugin.d.ts; echo ----; cat $D/index.d.ts | head -80; echo ----; cat $D/typings/index.d.ts | head -150

D=/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm; cat $D/shared/types/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -150; echo ----; cat $D/typings/config.d.ts | head -120; echo ----; cat $D/components/DashKit/index.d.ts | head -60; echo; cat $D/typings/common.d.ts | head -60

D=/home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm; cat $D/components/DashKit/DashKit.d.ts | head -90; echo ----; rg -n "MenuItems = |export const MenuItems" -A12 $D/constants/*.js | head -40; echo ----; rg -n "registerPlugins|setSettings|static" $D/components/DashKit/DashKit.d.ts

D=build/esm; ls $D/i18n; rg -n "css|import '" $D --glob '*.js' -l | head -5; rg -n "import .*\.css|styles.css" $D --glob '*.js' | head -5; rg -n "isDraggable|draggableHandle|draggableCancel|DRAGGABLE_CANCEL" $D/components/GridLayout/GridLayout.js | head; rg -n "MenuItems.Delete|defaultMenu|menu\b" $D/components/OverlayControls/*.js $D/components/DashKit/*.js 2>/dev/null | head -10; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npm view @gravity-ui/charts@2.0.0 peerDependencies dependencies 2>/dev/null

for v in $(npm view @gravity-ui/charts versions --json 2>/dev/null | tr -d '[],"' | tail -40); do echo -n "$v: "; npm view @gravity-ui/charts@$v peerDependencies --json 2>/dev/null | tr -d '\n '; echo; done 2>/dev/null | grep -i "uikit" | tail -15

npm install @gravity-ui/charts@1.73.0 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -3; grep -n '"@gravity-ui' package.json; bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh charts 2>&1 | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/build/docs 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs 2>/dev/null
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs && wc -l INDEX.md get-started.md examples.md; sed -n 1,200p get-started.md
cat /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/INDEX.md; ls /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Card Switch Button Text Flex Select DropdownMenu Lang configure ThemeProvider Icon Label 2>&1 | head -40; sed -n '/^## /p;/^### /p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | tail -30; rg -n "cols|rowHeight|margin" node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/constants/*.js | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/build 2>/dev/null | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && ls icons/build | grep -E "^(ArrowUp|ArrowDown|Plus|ArrowRotateLeft|Pencil|ChartColumn|ChartLine|Square|Check|Xmark|Persons|Cart|Bell|Clock|Gear|Eye|EyeSlash|ChartPie|Pulse|Layers|LayoutCells|Person|Dollar|ListUl|TriangleUp|TriangleDown|ArrowsRotateLeft)\.(js|d\.ts)$" | sort -u | head -40; rg -n "Ru\b|ru = " uikit/build/esm/components/*/index.d.ts uikit/build/esm/*/index.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -5; rg -l "enum Lang|Lang = " uikit/build/esm --glob '*.d.ts' | head -3

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/types.d.ts | rg -n -A4 "Lang" | head -20; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | head -30; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | wc -l; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json | rg '"(main|module|types)"'

cd node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons && ls | grep -E "^(ArrowUp|ArrowDown|Plus|ArrowRotateLeft|Pencil|ChartColumn|ChartLine|Xmark|Check|Persons|Bell|Clock|Gear|Layers|Dollar|ListUl|CircleCheck|Cart|Eye|Lock|ChartPie|ArrowsRotateRight|Rocket|ArrowRotateRight|Dashboard)\.d\.ts$" ; cd /home/sandbox/workspace && rg -n "export declare const Lang|Lang\s*=|RU|ru" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.d.ts | head; rg -n "ru" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/configure.d.ts | head -3; rg -rn "'ru'" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/utils/*.d.ts | head -3

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components && cat Card/Card.d.ts | head -40; echo ----; cat Switch/Switch.d.ts | head -40; echo ----; rg -n "interface DropdownMenuProps|renderSwitcher|items" -A3 DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu.d.ts | head -30; echo ----; rg -n "export type DropdownMenuItem|action|iconStart" DropdownMenu/types.d.ts | head; cat Text/Text.d.ts | head -20; rg -n "Button" ../../../../../uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts | head -3

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm && rg -n "cols|rowHeight|margin:|isDraggable|isResizable|compactType" components/GridLayout/*.js components/DashKit/DashKit.js | head -20; rg -n "class DashKit|setSettings" -A8 components/DashKit/DashKit.js | head -40

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs && sed -n 1,80p guides/series-types/bar-x.md | rg -v "^\s*$" | head -70; echo ----; rg -n "type: 'category'|categories|type: 'datetime'|type: 'linear'" -B2 -A6 guides/axes/axis-types.md | head -60; echo ----; rg -n "xAxis|yAxis" -A3 guides/series-types/line.md | head -30
cd /home/sandbox/workspace && npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | head -60
npx tsc --noEmit; echo "tsc exit=$?"; npm run build 2>&1 | grep -v "npm warn" | tail -25; echo "build exit=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"

cd /tmp/dash-check && sed -i "1i global.document = { hidden: false, addEventListener(){}, removeEventListener(){}, createElement(){return {style:{}}}, body:{} }; global.window = global; global.navigator = {userAgent:'node'}; global.localStorage = {getItem(){return null}, setItem(){}};" check.cjs && node check.cjs 2>&1 | tail -20
